about_short_description.short_description: Taobotics offers educational and enterprise robotic products and solutions. .

product.name: Q300 Cluster Formation Drone
product.description: A small drone platform designed for indoor and outdoor multi-drone formation flying, supporting secondary development with open-source code and multiple sensor integrations.

product.name: ROS-IMU Inertial Measurement Unit
product.description: An inertial measurement unit integrating gyroscope, accelerometer, and magnetometer with USB output and anti-interference algorithms for precise attitude sensing.

product.name: INS-M1 Power Inspection Robot
product.description: A low-speed indoor autonomous inspection robot equipped with multiple sensors for navigation, environment monitoring, and anomaly detection with automatic recharging.

identifier.value: QuickLink Electric Drive Robotic Arm End-Effector Quick Change Device

product.name: QuickLink Electric Drive Robotic Arm End-Effector Quick Change Device
product.description: An electric drive quick-change device for robotic arms and end-effectors enabling tool swapping without pneumatic systems, supporting plug-and-play and high load capacity.

identifier.value: RS-AGR Smart Agricultural Picking Robot Platform

product.name: RS-AGR Smart Agricultural Picking Robot Platform
product.description: A robotic platform combining mobile base, robotic arm, vision, and control systems for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and fruit and vegetable recognition in agricultural environments.

identifier.value: Thunder Mini Intelligent Differential Four-Wheel Drive Small Unmanned Vehicle

product.name: Thunder Mini Intelligent Differential Four-Wheel Drive Small Unmanned Vehicle
product.description: A small intelligent unmanned vehicle with differential four-wheel drive, equipped with sensors for autonomous navigation and adaptable for research, education, and competitions.
